visual_action: The video opens with a close-up of Donald Trump speaking at a podium with a blue background that partially reads 'BOARD of PEACE'. It then cuts to a fast-paced montage of US military assets in action. This includes clips of F-35 fighter jets flying in various conditions: taking off from an aircraft carrier, flying in formation above clouds, and performing maneuvers. There are also several clips of nighttime military operations, shown through green night-vision footage, featuring explosions and aircraft over a landscape. Other scenes show a large fire and explosion in a harbor at night and personnel working on the deck of an aircraft carrier. The video concludes with a black-and-white image of the White House building, over which the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' appears.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He appears on screen at the beginning of the video, speaking the lines that set the theme for the subsequent montage.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and ends with a title card showing the building and the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

on_screen_text.text: Some are playing a little cute
You can't play cute with me

spoken_summary: Donald Trump says, "Some are playing a little cute... you can't play cute with me." The rest of the audio is a rock song with lyrics including "A seven nation army couldn't hold me back."
audio_music: The audio begins with Donald Trump speaking. As he finishes, a high-energy, driving rock track with a famously recognizable bass riff immediately starts and continues for the rest of the video. The song creates an aggressive, intimidating, and powerful 'hype' atmosphere that complements the military montage. The track sounds like 'Seven Nation Army' by The White Stripes.
editing_pacing: The video features very fast-paced editing, using quick cuts to create a montage of various military actions and displays of hardware.
cultural_references: The song 'Seven Nation Army' by The White Stripes is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: The United States possesses overwhelming military power and, under this administration, will not hesitate to use it against any adversaries who 'play cute'.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel a sense of national pride and strength, while also serving as a warning to foreign adversaries, portraying the administration as powerful and resolute.
